topology_counts.counting_rule: Install entrypoint families, runtime forms, and payload densities are different axes and must be counted separately.

distribution_install_model.rule: Every supported App carrier converges through Framework-owned Base reconciliation and configured Package carriers by capability, minimum-version, or SemVer-range compatibility. App, Shell, Framework, Base, and Package release lines remain independent. Full changes seed density; Desktop and Container WebUI change runtime form; neither creates a second product or lifecycle authority.

machine_boundary: App-owned installation and Codex-visible exposure policy. Configured carriers own Package install, update, and remove; OPL Framework owns discovery, presence/callability aggregation, projected actions, and read models. Domain agents own skill semantics, domain handlers, action/stage truth, quality verdicts, and artifact authority.

policy_scope: which installer surfaces must expose progress
which App user path surfaces hide skill/plugin mechanics
which Codex-visible companion entries are expected after App-managed setup
which release gates prove the policy

canonical_metadata_sources.policy: App, CLI, plugin-packaged skills, direct skills, and product-entry surfaces must consume the same domain-owned action/stage metadata instead of maintaining parallel semantic maps.

software_lifecycle.full_first_install_boundary: A Full carrier may seed Base and Package payloads; Framework activates Base, configured carriers activate Packages, and App renders fresh projected readback.

installer_model.windows_online_command: download install-docker-webui.ps1 from the GitHub Latest Release and run with -EnableAutoUpdate -Yes

windows.id: One Person Lab WebUI Stable Update
windows.legacy_id_migrated_on_enable: One Person Lab WebUI Latest Update

cloud_deployment_model.reverse_proxy: Caddy automatic HTTPS in front of the WebUI container

rows.one_click_install: Run the one-click installer to create compose.yaml, data/projects directories, and start the WebUI image.
rows.browser_webui: Open http://localhost:3000/ or the administrator-provided WebUI URL.
rows.access_key_settings: Sign in to OPL Gateway or enter an API Key in WebUI first-run or Settings -> Account & Access.
rows.runtime_proxy: Gateway account sign-in and API Key configuration reuse the existing OPL runtime provider and dedicated stdin commands.
rows.startup_recovery: If startup fails, collect the redacted startup diagnostics and rerun after the Docker, port, image, or data issue is fixed.
rows.data_preservation: Keep host OnePersonLab/data and OnePersonLab/projects mounted and preserved across image/container replacement.
rows.host_update: Update the WebUI image from the host by rerunning the installer, using its explicit update mode, or enabling the user-scoped Windows scheduled task; the browser WebUI must not self-update containers through a Docker socket.

ordinary_user_status.image_seed_selection: Default stable image must use the WebUI full seed; --tag latest is explicit Preview opt-in and --image is an advanced override.

status_surfaces: OPL maintenance status after WebUI opens

image_update_model.currentness_claim_policy: remote digest comparison is status-only; it does not prove release readiness, the live stable channel, or that a host update was applied

runtime_distribution_model.rule: Docker/WebUI presents a browser-first install experience; image updates and OPL-managed runtime/module updates are separate planes, and user state remains in mounted host directories.

first_run_user_presentation.primary_message: One Person Lab is preparing OPL Base, OPL App, and OPL Packages.

managed_commands: opl family-runtime service supervisor status --provider temporal
opl family-runtime service supervisor install --provider temporal
opl family-runtime service supervisor trigger --provider temporal

agent_installation_contract.state_source: opl app state --profile fast --json#app_state.agent_packages.directory + status_index + actions

directory_contract.installed_state_source: fresh configured-carrier readback aggregated by Framework

carrier_boundary.Framework_role: adapter discovery, fresh complete-runtime aggregation, route readiness, and projected actions
carrier_boundary.App_role: render projection and submit user intent

app_must_not_own: carrier cache or physical path fallback

must_verify: non-blocking companion skill and plugin maintenance
Codex-visible MAS/MAG/RCA/OMA entries without duplicate semantics
